coverage: Additive CHF (SNB), NZD (RBNZ), and EIA (Weekly Petroleum Status Report) schedules for Dev 2018-2024 and Live 2026-2027 (extending 6-CCY SSOT to 8-CCY + EIA)
sources: snb.ch — Swiss National Bank quarterly Monetary Policy Assessments 2018-2024 (28 dates) & 2026-2027 (8 dates), Thursdays 09:30 Europe/Zurich (VERIFIED_T1)

rbnz.govt.nz — Reserve Bank of New Zealand OCR decisions 2018-2024 (48 scheduled dates; 2018 Thu 09:00 Pacific/Auckland -> 2019+ Wed 14:00 Pacific/Auckland; 2020-03-25 cancelled) & 2026-2027 (7 dates in 2026 + 8 dates in 2027 expansion, Wed 14:00 Pacific/Auckland) (VERIFIED_T1)

eia.gov — U.S. EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report (WPSR) schedule: Wednesdays 10:30 America/New_York; US Federal Holiday Mon/Tue/Wed shifts to Thursday (11:00 ET historical 2018-2024 rule [DETERMINISTIC_PRIMARY_SCHEDULE_VERIFIED]; 12:00 ET verified on eia.gov/petroleum/supply/weekly/schedule.php for all 12 2026-2027 holiday Thursdays [VERIFIED_T1])
notes: Strictly additive to frozen red_news_official_2018_2024_6ccy.json, red_news_official_2026_2027_multi_ccy.json, and production naqex_red_news_utc.csv (none modified).
Holdout year 2025 is strictly excluded; dev_2018_2024 and live_2026_2027 sections are explicitly separated.
RBNZ transitioned from Thursday 09:00 NZT (2018) to Wednesday 14:00 NZT effective February 2019 (MPC reform), and expands from 7 to 8 scheduled OCR meetings/year starting 2027.
RBNZ scheduled 2020-03-25 OCR review was officially cancelled after the unscheduled 2020-03-16 COVID-19 emergency cut.

EIA primary-source correction captured: 2026-2027 holiday-shifted Thursday releases on eia.gov/petroleum/supply/weekly/schedule.php are officially published at 12:00 ET (12/12 dates verified T1), whereas historical 2018-2024 holiday-shifted weeks follow the documented Thursday 11:00 ET primary schedule rule.

unverified_gaps.reason: Extraordinary cut date verified (which also cancelled scheduled 2020-03-25 review), but exact press-release UTC minute not backfilled from archive; omitted rather than guessed.

unverified_gaps.reason: Historical 2018-2024 holiday shifts apply the documented Thu 11:00 ET deterministic primary rule; individual archival Christmas/New Year Friday shifts or late-2024 12:00 ET adjustments were not individually scraped from historical PDFs and are flagged honestly.
